roles.O1: highest score among riders not assigned A/B/M3/R1L/R1B; tie lower car number
roles.O2: second-highest score among remaining riders; tie lower car number

early.formation_definition: For each third role in A, B, R1L, buy all 6 permutations of {O1,O2,third}; 18 points total.

middle.selection_note: Chosen over the higher-ROI two-condition middle rule because the two-condition family passed targeted leave-one-year-out only 2/3; this one-condition rule has a larger sample and lower selection complexity.

interpretation: Development ROI is not expected future ROI. The strategy intentionally accepts long losing streaks in exchange for larger recovery multiples and wider semantic formations.
evaluation_caveat: This strategy family was conceived after prior 2026 H1 strategy failures were observed, so 2026 H1 is not a pristine untouched OOS for the family-level hypothesis. A genuinely fresh forward period should be preferred for final validation.
